title: Understanding Regularization
text: Regularization is a technique used to prevent overfitting in machine learning models. It adds a penalty to the loss function to discourage complex models. Can you think of how this might affect bias?

title: Types of Regularization
text: There are different types of regularization, such as L1 and L2. L1 regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients, while L2 adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude. How might these affect the model's complexity?

title: Effect on Bias
text: Does regularization increase or decrease model bias?

title: Regularization and Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Regularization affects the bias-variance tradeoff. Does it typically increase bias and decrease variance, or decrease bias and increase variance?
